references.text: The temple of Baal-Berith is mentioned again, showing that this was an important idolatrous temple in Shechem.
Jephthah also gathered worthless men around him, in a similar way to how Abimelech hired empty and reckless men.
David also gathered men in distress and those burdened by debt around him, a similar pattern of gathering marginalized men.
Rehoboam was also influenced by empty and wicked men who gathered around him.
Silver used for evil purposes, a theme that recurs when money is used for unjust ends.
The Jews in Thessalonica also hired wicked men from the marketplace to create an uprising, similar to Abimelech's actions.
